Subject: Architecture deep-dive: Redwood runtime & deployment review

Hi Tom —

Per our intro call last week, I'd love to schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive to walk through the Redwood serving runtime, deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private), and some suggested configuration for your high-throughput inference use case. We'll cover latency profiles, caching, and a short demo of the compilation/kernel selection behavior.

Proposed slot (60 min):
- Wed, Jun 30 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT

Agenda (high level):
- 10m recap of requirements
- 25m runtime architecture + model serving tradeoffs
- 15m demo (live run, KV cache behavior)
- 10m next steps and Q&A

I've attached the deck we'll use and added a calendar invite — please accept if this time works. If not, reply with a couple windows and we'll rebook.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
